title: Hello, Little Hands
desc: You discovered your own hands, opening and closing them slowly like you were testing out something brand new, because you were. Watching you meet your own fingers for the first time was quietly one of the sweetest things we have ever seen.
story: You were lying on your back, calm and content, when we noticed your gaze had drifted upward toward your own raised hand. You seemed genuinely puzzled by it, studying it the way you might study something completely foreign, turning it slightly, watching it with those wide, serious eyes. Then the fingers began to move, spreading open and curling back in, slow and deliberate, like you were sending a signal to yourself and waiting to see if it would arrive. We sat beside you without making a sound, not wanting to pull your attention away from this very important discovery you were making. There was something almost meditative about it, this tiny person quietly learning that their body belonged to them. You did it again and again, each time with the same careful concentration, as if you were memorizing the feeling. It was such a small thing, and yet we found ourselves with full hearts, watching you introduce yourself to yourself for the very first time.
